comparisons.peer_summary: On August 17, 2024, AMD agreed to acquire ZT Systems for approximately $4.9 billion, consisting of 8,335,852 shares of common stock and $3.4 billion in cash, with contingent consideration of up to 740,964 shares and $300 million payable upon meeting certain conditions.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and AVGO disclose major acquisitions executed in the fiscal period that utilized a combined cash and stock consideration structure to fund the transaction. AVGO's acquisition of VMware in November 2023 involved $30,788 million in cash and $53,398 million in stock, whereas AMD's agreement to acquire ZT Systems in August 2024 involves $3.4 billion in cash and 8,335,852 shares of common stock. Both disclosures highlight the strategic intent behind the deals, with AVGO acquiring VMware to enhance infrastructure software capabilities and AMD acquiring ZT Systems to provide AI and compute infrastructure.

sentences.text: On November 22, 2023, we completed the acquisition of VMware, Inc. ("VMware") in a cash-and-stock transaction (the "VMware Merger").
The VMware stockholders received approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock (on a split adjusted basis) with a fair value of $53,398 million.
We acquired VMware to enhance our infrastructure software capabilities.

On August 17, 2024, the Company entered into an agreement (the Agreement) to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems), a provider of AI and general purpose compute infrastructure for hyperscale computing companies, in a cash and stock transaction valued at approximately $4.9 billion (the Acquisition).
The aggregate closing consideration payable by the Company consists of 8,335,852 shares of the Company's common stock and $3.4 billion in cash.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD completed the acquisition of Xilinx on February 14, 2022, for $48.8 billion ($46.4 billion net of cash acquired), with the consideration allocated to $27.3 billion of intangible assets, $1.3 billion of identifiable net liabilities, and $22.8 billion of goodwill.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose significant past acquisitions completed within the current fiscal year reporting period, detailing the total purchase consideration. AVGO completed the VMware acquisition on November 22, 2023, valued at approximately $84,186 million. Similarly, AMD discloses the completion of the Xilinx acquisition on February 14, 2022, for a total consideration of $48.8 billion. While the dates differ (2023 vs 2022), both are treated as key strategic events with substantial financial impact reported in Item 8.
